name: @amodalai/example-underwriting-review
description: An Amodal example that triages commercial insurance submissions against an underwriting guide: a composite tool that delegates the judgment to a reviewer subagent, four stores, a custom React UI, a Gmail connection whose read-only surface syncs submissions in and whose confirm-gated surface emails outcomes back, and preToolUse guard hooks that enforce the hard rules platform-wide.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.steps.json

amodal.name: underwriting-review-example
amodal.description: Triage commercial property submissions against a fictional underwriting guide. The underwriting-reviewer subagent scores each submission and recommends a workflow status for a human underwriter. The agent assists; a human decides.
